status: Local design prototype. Memory and automations are P0 product contracts; historical backtesting is a P1 backend capability.

reference_evidence.observed: Knowledge graph beside a note reader; searchable Markdown-note list; linked notes and context summary; separate execution-policy editor lower on the page.
reference_evidence.adapt: Nest keeps the graph, reader, note search and linked navigation. Accepted preferences and proposals remain distinct; policy editing moves to the existing Guardrails authority. Do not inherit Pilot's automatic-execution or mandatory caps.

reference_evidence.inspection: Resolved through the live Backtests navigation because the supplied backtest URL duplicated Memory and included a trailing comma.
reference_evidence.observed: Bounded configuration, sample/historical modes, post-cost equity and benchmark, drawdown/cost/fill metrics, event audit, saved-run comparison and frozen reproducibility evidence.
reference_evidence.adapt: Nest uses a compact configuration rail and dominant evidence/results area. Preview calculations use explicitly synthetic XLM/USDC observations. Real historical replay remains a separately implemented service.

reference_evidence.inspection: Browser inspected after asynchronous content loaded
reference_evidence.observed: Strategy presets, editable bounds, review-first simulated lifecycle, per-event checks, portfolio effect and event timeline.
reference_evidence.adapt: Nest's P0 builder starts from arbitrary supported conditions, not a fixed strategy menu. Use Source→Condition→Action, one test, explicit revision review and activation. P0 actions notify or propose an action; no unattended signing.

screens.title: Lab / Memory
screens.layout: Page title and Memory/Backtests/Automations tabs; graph and source-note reader in two columns; searchable note list; accepted/proposed preference and policy-boundary disclosure.
interactions: Click graph node or list item to select a source note
Filter note list without changing stored memory
Inspect/edit accepted recommendation context under explicit owner control
Accept a preference proposal through its ID/revision
Reset a chosen personal-memory scope with confirmation
Open Guardrails for policy; a memory edit cannot change policy
states: Guest transient context / connect to save
screens.responsive: Two columns on wide workspaces; graph, reader and list stack below 1024px or container width 850px. Graph can pan internally on narrow screens; the complete note list is the accessible alternative.
accessibility: Native 44px note buttons and visible focus
Graph text/relationships described by the reader/list
Selection state uses aria-pressed and text
Editable body is labeled; reset scope and effect are explicit

backend_bindings.purpose: Read and explicitly change soft preferences
Memory graph/note aggregation, notes editing, reset/export and pagination are not fully specified endpoints. Do not invent paths.
Policy reference only; writes remain explicit Guardrails Save

acceptance: Node/list selection shows the correct source note and timestamps
Proposals never appear accepted without explicit acceptance
No memory operation changes financial plans, policy, approvals or receipts
Guest context is not silently persisted

screens.title: Lab / Backtests
screens.layout: 320px experiment configuration rail beside post-cost results and benchmark chart; event audit; frozen evidence and compatible saved runs below.
configuration: Window, interval, warm-up and out-of-sample boundary
Spread, venue fee, slippage and fixed costs
result_fields: Net return, drawdown, turnover and costs
Signals, later fills and rejected events
screens.preview_behavior: Run sample computes a deterministic allocation-band example over 16 fixed invented XLM/USDC prices. Signal at one observation, fill at the next, bounded notional, modeled costs. Page-session comparison/export only; not a historical run or permission to trade.

backend_bindings.status: Specified P1 create/status/result family; methods and status/result path shapes to finalize

screens.responsive: Configuration stacks before results below 768px/container 850px. Charts redraw at measured width with readable units; audit tables scroll inside their own region.
acceptance: UI never fabricates a historical candle or historical executable fill
Costs, benchmark and coverage stay visible
No signing, policy mutation or financial action from a run

screens.title: Lab / Automations
screens.layout: 260px owned-rule rail; natural-language draft at top; typed Source→Condition→Action editor beside human-readable rule and test/evaluation timeline.
flow: Review exact revision, coverage, cadence, expiry and costs
Notify or create expiring review proposal
screens.preview_behavior: Test uses an explicitly labeled fixture observation. Disconnected X yields unknown. Preview activation changes only local visual state and starts no scheduler. Production crossing transforms require previous observations and freshness; the preview does not claim a real crossing.

backend_bindings.purpose: Accessible source, field, transform, cadence and entitlement catalog
Session-bound OAuth/PKCE; no activation from callback
Versioned edit, effect-free test and explicit schedule changes

acceptance: No fixed strategy menu limits arbitrary supported rules
Unknown/stale/missing observations never become zero or a trigger
One trigger per tenant/revision/event key; retries do not duplicate proposals
Real activation requires verified owner and exact revision acceptance
Triggered actions re-prepare fresh quotes/policy and require normal user review
